one_liner: A builder that plans strictly from retrieved documentation — never from memory, never improvised.
what_it_does: Ask it to build something and it first fetches the real docs, then writes a plan where every step cites what it read. It can't plan from memory — every claim traces to a doc passage, or the plan doesn't ship. Proven by 1 real transaction — an ERC20 token deployed and verified from a doc-cited plan — linked below.
